steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each file is placed by its effect on loading and on the third-party cost.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: LCP image is lazy-loaded
findings.fix: Load the hero image eagerly with high priority

findings.title: Third-party script blocks rendering
findings.fix: Load it with defer or async

outcome.notChecked: Real-user data if none was given, server response time and CDN configuration, low-end devices and slow networks unless tested, and features whose support was not confirmed for the targets.
